note: Bundled fallback so the FindHelp map is never empty when the live Supabase RPC is unreachable. 24 hand-curated Greater Boston / MA locations: 16 help-directory entries (DTA offices, food pantries, combined-service orgs) plus 8 EBT-retailer entries (supermarkets, small grocers, farmers markets, and a co-op) that demonstrate where SNAP benefits can actually be spent. Coordinates are approximate; addresses are public-record best-effort; every entry is marked as seed data in notes so the user is warned to call ahead. The MA Restaurant Meals Program is not represented because MA does not currently operate RMP. When the live RPC is healthy these entries are unused.
